findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evictions_submit_case, evictions_get_case_events, evictions_get_payment_link, evictions_list_case_messages · Private data: evictions_get_started, evictions_resolve_jurisdiction, evictions_create_case, evictions_update_case, evictions_get_case, evictions_list_cases, evictions_validate_case, evictions_submit_case, evictions_get_case_events, evictions_list_case_charges, evictions_get_payment_link, evictions_list_case_messages, evictions_send_case_message, evictions_withdraw_case · Public sink: evictions_validate_case, evictions_submit_case, evictions_send_case_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evictions_submit_case, evictions_get_case_events, evictions_get_payment_link, evictions_list_case_messages · Private data: evictions_get_started, evictions_resolve_jurisdiction, evictions_create_case, evictions_update_case, evictions_get_case, evictions_list_cases, evictions_validate_case, evictions_submit_case, evictions_get_case_events, evictions_list_case_charges, evictions_get_payment_link, evictions_list_case_messages, evictions_send_case_message, evictions_withdraw_case · Public sink: evictions_validate_case, evictions_submit_case, evictions_send_case_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
